hotel_name: Hotel Sarthak Palace, Karol Bagh, Delhi

positive_snippets: Hotel Sarthak Palace, Karol Bagh is a comfortable and well-maintained stay option with a warm and helpful staff. The rooms are clean, spacious, and equipped with all basic amenities needed for a pleasant stay. Its prime location makes it easy to access markets, metro stations, and major attractions of Delhi. Overall, it offers good value for money and a peaceful experience for both business and leisure travelers.
The rooms were really good and the food was so delicious, must consider visiting here....hanuman kumar(service)

Inside Channa market and this is a legacy hotel used by our company since many years. Property is a bit dated however service is excellent and warm. Walkable distance from Karol bagh metro station also.
